0022600160.text: The Pacers (2-5, 0-3 at home, on a four-game losing streak) host the Hawks (3-4, coming off a loss) for the eighth game of the Pacers' season, with Indiana 12th in the East and third in the Central, 3.5 games back, and Atlanta 7th in the East and 0.5 games behind in second in the Southeast. Indiana is missing Aaron Nesmith (rest), Andrew Nembhard (neck), Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Pascal Siakam (rest), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while Larry Nance Jr. (illness) and Obi Toppin (back soreness) are day-to-day; Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), Kingston Flemings is suspended, and Jalen Johnson is day-to-day with an ankle injury. The teams have not met yet this season, and in their last meeting on January 31 in Indianapolis, the Pacers won 129-124.
